First, find the score of the second student:  
3 wrong out of 40 means 40 - 3 = 37 correct.  
As a percentage: (37 / 40) × 100 = 92.5%.  

The first student scored 95%, which is higher than 92.5%.  
So the top score to beat is 95%.  

To get the highest score, Hannah must beat 95%.  
If the test has 40 questions (same as the second student’s test), then:  
95% of 40 = 0.95 × 40 = 38 questions correct.  
To have the highest score, she needs at least 39 correct (since 39/40 = 97.5%).  

Final answer: Hannah
